reasons: Imported checkpoint has not been qualified on SafeSight validation and untouched test recordings.
The one-class checkpoint does not provide person, lighter, or smoke cues required for complete smoking analysis.
Alert thresholds have not been calibrated to the configured target precision.

dataset.provenance: User-provided cigarette_detection checkpoint; training dataset provenance was not supplied.

known_limitations: This candidate detects visible cigarettes only; it cannot detect people, lighters, or smoke.
Hidden-cigarette smoking inference is unavailable with this candidate alone.
Accuracy, alert precision, alert recall, and operating thresholds are unverified.
